name: Barbell Rollout
steps: Kneel on the floor behind a barbell fitted with round rolling plates and grip it shoulder-width apart beneath your shoulders.
Tuck your pelvis slightly, brace your abs tightly, and squeeze your glutes with straight arms.
Roll the bar slowly forward along the floor, letting your hips and shoulders move together as far as you hold a flat back.
Press downward through the bar and pull it smoothly back beneath your shoulders using your abs and lats.
tips: Stop the outward roll immediately before your lower back starts to sag.
Keep your elbows locked straight throughout rather than pulling with bent arms.
